arms.name: Craft v3, subject only
arms.idea: Craft v2 without the staged base: the code goes to the subject

arms.name: Craft v3, flat colour only
arms.idea: craft3 with every texture ask cut: texture-free copies of contract, taste, ambition2 and craft3 that ask for one flat colour per part and detail carried by geometry, and no paint.ts or texture.ts source

arms.name: Craft v3, parallel parts
arms.idea: craft3 split across concurrent calls: one planning call writes a shared spec (size, palette, mounts, skeleton, 3-6 parts), then one call per part writes a function into the shared builder, all at once; the runner assembles one module

arms.name: Craft v3, parallel parts in flat colour
arms.idea: the flat arm's system prompt split across concurrent calls like par: one planning call writes the shared spec, then one call per part writes a function, all at once; flat-colour copies of the plan and part prompts (one colour string per part, no texture or paint option)
